trust_decision.summary: Which INTERNAL_ERROR messages may reach a remote client: server-side faults (serializer errors, broadcast lag, push-delivery errors, store invariants) must be replaced by a generic message and logged at the raise site, while an executor's own INTERNAL_ERROR text keeps passing through the response boundary unchanged.

landing_point.why: The summary names error.rs; A2AError::internal and its to_jsonrpc_error/http mapping live in a2a/src/errors.rs, so an engineer starts there or at the response boundaries (a2a-server/src/jsonrpc.rs:254, a2a-server/src/rest.rs:449), not at the raise sites.

fix_sites.entry_point: REST HTTP routes returning a ProtoJSON body (get task, list tasks, push config, extended agent card) via protojson_json_response
REST streaming routes (message:stream, task subscribe) via protojson_stream
SubscribeToTask / SendStreamingMessage on every transport when a subscriber lags the broadcast channel
fix_sites.module_kind: core request handler (shared by all transports)

fix_sites.entry_point: Any SendMessage/stream that triggers push delivery with fail_on_error set (HttpPushSender::send_push via handler.rs:210)
fix_sites.module_kind: outbound webhook client (looks out of scope)

fix_sites.module_kind: storage backend (lower-level public API, TaskStore trait impl)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: a2a-server/src/task_store/inmemory.rs:42 (TaskStore impl); also outbound push client a2a-server/src/push/sender.rs:151-158

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The store's 'task already exists' and the push sender's delivery error look like internal plumbing rather than response code, and the push error only surfaces when the opt-in fail_on_error is set, so a solver can argue they are not client-facing; the JSON-RPC serialization twin can be dismissed as 'the advisory/test only shows REST'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An AgentExecutor's own INTERNAL_ERROR (e.g. 'stream failed') must keep its message through the JSON-RPC/REST/SSE boundary, and non-internal errors (task not found, invalid params, parse errors) keep their detail; sanitizing by code at error_response/rest_error_response/to_jsonrpc_error breaks both.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JSON-RPC unary responses: protojson_value wraps the ProtoJSON serializer error text into a client-visible INTERNAL_ERROR, the exact twin of fixed rest.rs:401
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory's tests and diff only exercise REST; JSON-RPC is a separate binding and its error_response test is changed to assert pass-through, which reads as 'JSON-RPC intentionally passes messages'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same crate, different file from the fixed REST site; 1 file from landing boundary

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JSON-RPC streaming (SendStreamingMessage, SubscribeToTask): protojson_stream puts the serializer error text into the SSE JSON-RPC error frame, twin of fixed rest.rs:413
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; streaming errors on this path are mostly executor-originated so a solver may assume the boundary must stay untouched and miss that this map_err is a raise site.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A fallible pbconv conversion on the gRPC response path that maps its error into A2AError::internal with the conversion detail
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The REST/JSON-RPC bindings already do fallible ProtoJSON transcoding with formatted errors; a maintainer making the gRPC conversion fallible would copy that idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: map_stream_response encoding failure formatted into an internal error with encoder detail
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a2a-slimrpc/src/common.rs:53 already formats decode errors into A2AError::internal on the client side; a server-side encode check would mirror it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An InMemoryPushConfigStore invariant (duplicate id / capacity) raised as A2AError::internal with internal state in the message
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same shape as the fixed InMemoryTaskStore duplicate-create error in a sibling store.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: save_task wrapping a store update failure into an internal error carrying the store's message
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: save_task is the persistence chokepoint and already special-cases store error codes.

O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests in a2a-server/src/{rest,jsonrpc,sse,handler}.rs mod tests (axum oneshot, no network); CLI e2e in a2acli/tests/e2e.rs spins a local server; a2a-slimrpc/tests/e2e.rs may need SLIM.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite every INTERNAL_ERROR message to 'Internal error' in error_response/rest_error_response/to_jsonrpc_error, which hides executor failure reports (breaks a2acli e2e 'stream failed') and still is not where the fix belongs.
